title: Blocklists
description: The blocked-site lists a household can sync, one row per list: its category, plain-words label, which age bands start with it on and which cannot turn it off. Pins (source, checksum, size) live in the signed catalog list index, never here. A list id the catalog index names that this file does not is ignored.

version.description: The review month of this policy, such as 2026.10.

does.description: One plain-words line, shown beside the list's name.

default_for.description: Bands that start with this list on.

locked_for.description: Bands that cannot turn this list off. Always on for them and never offered as an option.
